task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First thing I need you to do is to travel west. After that, make an attempt to go west. If you can do that, make an effort to head south. After that, pick-up the sandwich from the floor of the bedchamber. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
Here we are in the office. You start to take note of what's in the room.

You see a suitcase.

There is an open gateway leading north. There is an open portal leading south. There is an open passageway leading west.

thought: I should go west first as instructed.
feedback:
You arrive in a study. A standard kind of place.

What's that over there? It looks like it's a case. The case is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever!

There is an open passageway leading east. There is an open hatch leading west.

feedback:
You've entered a restroom.

If you haven't noticed it already, there seems to be something there by the wall, it's a box. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a table. The table is ordinary. But the thing is empty. Hm. Oh well

There is an open hatch leading east. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
